# VertiWiki 0.3.0 Documentation
> VertiWiki is a 100% static, zero-backend, single-file Markdown wiki and documentation engine for 2026 and beyond.

## Core Documentation
* [Welcome & Overview](index.md): Introduction to VertiWiki capabilities and architecture.
* [Installation Guide](docs/getting-started/installation.md): Quick setup, local testing, and subfolder demonstration.
* [Modern Features](features.md): List of modern 2026+ frontend features (Tabs, Details, Lightbox, Badges, Wikilinks).
* [Theme System & Templates](themes.md): Multi-theme engine, dedicated theme files in themes/, design tokens, and custom palettes.
* [Visual Sitemap](sitemap.md): Interactive directory tree with instant real-time live search.

## Technical Architecture & APIs
* [Technical Architecture Overview](docs/architecture/overview.md): Core lifecycle pipeline, hash routing, and single-file bundling.
* [Theme Engine & Tokens](docs/architecture/theme-engine.md): Complete design token mapping, color palettes, and font configuration.
* [Plugin Development API](docs/api/plugins.md): Async pipeline hooks (beforeParse, afterParse, afterRender) and custom plugin development.

## Guides & Operations
* [Authoring Guide](docs/guides/authoring.md): Writing in Markdown with GFM, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, tabs, details, and subfolders.
* [Wikilinks & Cross-Referencing](docs/guides/wikilinks.md): Fast bidirectional [[wikilinks]] syntax, aliases, anchors, and Obsidian vault compatibility.
* [Deployment Guide](docs/guides/deployment.md): Static hosting setup (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, S3) and Universal Analytics configuration.
* [XML Sitemaps & SEO Guide](docs/guides/sitemap-seo.md): Generating sitemap.xml with online tools for search engine indexing.
* [Advanced Configuration](docs/advanced/configuration.md): Deep subfolder hierarchy and navigation setup.

## Project & Roadmap
* [Changelog & Release Notes](Changelog.md): Complete version changelog for all releases.
* [Versioning Policy & Roadmap](docs/versioning-and-roadmap.md): Semantic versioning policy and future milestones.
